name: Innsbruck Lifestyle Market & Food Truck Festival
beschreibung: The Lifestyle Market in Innsbruck brings vibrant food truck culture to the alpine capital. Over 30 food trucks featuring international street food join forces with regional producers. The event also boasts live cooking shows, a gin distillery lounge, and an entertaining musical programme across the festival grounds.
kurzbeschreibung: Street food from around the globe, live cooking shows, and a lifestyle market in the heart of Innsbruck.
